title: Glassnode：以太坊（ETH）活跃度因新用户涌入而翻倍
subTitle:
以太坊的活跃地址数量在一个月内几乎翻倍，达到800万，而日交易量因稳定币使用激增创下历史新高，达到280万笔。

据加密链上分析平台Glassnode称，过去一个月“活动留存率”几乎翻倍，表明以太坊网络的新用户出现明显增长。
据Glassnode周四报告，按月比较的“活动留存率”在新群体中大幅飙升，“表明过去30天首次交互地址激增”。
其补充称，这反映了与以太坊网络交互的新钱包显著涌入，“而非仅由现有参与者驱动的活动”。
新的活动留存（即新增网络地址）本月已从略高于400万飙升至约800万。
活动留存衡量的是随时间推移仍保持活跃的用户数量，核心在于用户是否留下并持续使用网络，而非只出现一次就消失。
以太坊活跃留存率创历史新高。来源：Glassnode
以太坊每日交易量创新高
据Etherscan显示，过去一年，以太坊网络的活跃地址数量已从去年同期约41万增长到1月15日超过100万，翻倍有余。
与此同时，周四以太坊每日交易次数飙升至历史新高280万，较去年同期增长125%。
据Milk Road周四称，随着费用大幅下降，稳定币在以太坊上的使用爆发式增长，是推动这一现象的原因。
其表示：“这是以太坊将执行层推向L2、同时在L1保持结算安全的结果。这才是可扩展金融基础设施的真实形态。”
以太坊稳定币用量在创纪录低手续费下达历史新高。来源：Token Terminal 
“以太坊值得看好”
Arctic Digital研究主管Justin d'Anethan对Cointelegraph表示，围绕以太坊的信心和情绪正在改善。“观察以太坊，有很多值得乐观的因素。”
他补充称：“短期内，已被压至超卖区的指标出现回升，似乎在暗示更高的价格，受到资金重返ETF、稳定币和原生加密协议的推动。”
LVRG Research总监Nick Ruck指出，随着每日交易次数突破200万、质押已接近3600万以太币，以太坊的网络活动激增。

Ethereum (ETH) is one of the most powerful and influential blockchain platforms in the crypto world. Launched in 2015 by Vitalik Buterin, Ethereum introduced the concept of smart contracts, which completely changed how blockchain technology is used today.

Unlike Bitcoin, which is mainly used as digital money, Ethereum is a decentralized platform that allows developers to build and run applications without any central authority. These applications are known as dApps (Decentralized Applications).
Smart Contracts and Use Cases
Ethereum’s smart contracts automatically execute agreements when conditions are met. This feature has enabled:
DeFi (Decentralized Finance) platforms
NFT marketplaces
Blockchain-based games
DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations)
Ethereum 2.0 and Scalability
Ethereum has successfully transitioned to Proof of Stake (PoS), making the network more energy-efficient and scalable. This upgrade helps reduce gas fees and improves transaction speed, making Ethereum more attractive for long-term adoption.
ETH as an Investment
ETH is not just a utility token; it is also considered a strong long-term investment. With continuous development, a large developer community, and growing real-world use cases, Ethereum remains a top choice for both investors and builders.
Final Thoughts
Ethereum continues to lead innovation in the blockchain ecosystem. As Web3, DeFi, and NFTs grow, Ethereum’s role becomes even more important. ETH is not just a cryptocurrency—it is the foundation of the decentralized future.

Solana’s Response to the “Exit Test” — A Different Survival Logic

This wasn’t a technical debate.
It was about what actually keeps a blockchain alive.

After Vitalik Buterin argued that Ethereum must pass an “exit” or detachment test, toly responded with a simpler view: if Solana ever stops serving developers and users, it will perish. No test required.

That framing matters.

Vitalik’s idea optimizes for ideological resilience — a protocol that survives without any single leader or team. Toly’s argument optimizes for economic reality. Decentralization alone doesn’t keep a network alive. Usage does.

In his view, Solana must generate real on-chain value, convert that activity into revenue, and reinvest it into tooling, infrastructure, and upstream improvements. The protocol shouldn’t try to solve everything. Choosing what not to solve is part of staying viable.

This isn’t Solana versus Ethereum.
It’s philosophy versus execution.
Protocols don’t fail because they lack perfect detachment.

They fail when developers stop building and users stop coming.
